# thousandeyes_disable_endpoint_agent (Action)

Disables a ThousandEyes endpoint agent. An action rather than a resource: it is a one-shot operation with nothing for Terraform to reconcile, and the agent's enabled state is not something this manages over time.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) The identifier of the endpoint agent to disable. Disabling an agent stops it running tests without deleting it, so the operation is reversible by the matching enable action.
